services.desc: Oregon's Top Rated Fishing Experience. At Nomad's you don't just pay to catch the fish you are in pursuit of. You pay for the experience and the knowledge your guide has. Damon is a master angler. He knows his fish, knows how to teach his clients, and takes care of you from the first phone call to fileting your fish. Join us for an unforgettable salmon and steelhead fishing experience in Oregon! Capt. Damon will take you to the best spots to hook into the legendary Chinook, Coho salmon or steelhead. blurb: Nomad's Fishing Adventures offers guided fishing trips in Oregon targeting species such as salmon, steelhead, halibut, kokanee, sturgeon, lingcod, rock fish, and crabbing. Trips are tailored to catch trophy fish or to load up on fresh fish. They operate year-round with different fishing locations and species available depending on the season.
